# Similarweb Names Michael Akkerman as New Chief Executive Officer

 September 24, 2026 9:35 am EDT Download as PDF 

 TEL AVIV, Israel--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Similarweb Ltd. (NYSE: SMWB), a leading digital data and analytics company, today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Michael Akkerman as Chief Executive Officer, effective November 2, 2026. Mr. Akkerman succeeds Founder and CEO Or Offer, who, as previously announced in May 2026, is stepping down after close to two decades leading the Company. 

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260924139413/en/

Michael Akkerman

 Mr. Akkerman brings nearly 20 years of C-level and senior operating leadership across digital advertising, data, and technology businesses. He currently serves as Chief Business Officer of Digital Turbine (NASDAQ: APPS), leading a global team spanning sales, partnerships, marketing, product, and business operations. He previously served as Chief Revenue Officer of data.ai (formerly App Annie), where he led all go-to-market functions - sales, marketing, business development, and corporate strategy - for a platform providing app and market intelligence to many of the same enterprise customers Similarweb serves today. 

 Earlier, he served as Chief Product and Strategy Officer at Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX), leading product alongside engineering, and held senior commercial leadership roles at both Uber (NYSE: UBER) and Pinterest (NYSE: PINS). Earlier in his career, he held global sales and strategy leadership roles at Kenshoo (now Skai), an Israeli-founded enterprise marketing software company. He holds a degree from the University of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia. 

 Michael will be based in and lead from Similarweb's New York office. 

 Or Offer will remain closely involved through a transition period, supporting Mr. Akkerman and the Board to ensure continuity for customers, partners, and employees. 

 Harel Beit-On, Chairman of the Board of Similarweb, said, “On behalf of the Board, I want to start by thanking Or for his extraordinary leadership since founding the company. He built Similarweb from the ground up into the company it is today, and we are deeply grateful for his vision, his partnership, and the culture he created. As we turn to our next chapter, this appointment is the culmination of a thorough and disciplined search process. Michael brings exactly the combination of data fluency, operating rigor, strategic depth, and multidisciplinary leadership this next phase calls for, and the Board has full confidence in him and in the continuity of Similarweb's bold vision.” 

 Or Offer, Founder and outgoing CEO of Similarweb, said, “I've spent almost 20 years building this company, and I couldn't be prouder of where we stand today - a business that has successfully navigated its transition into the AI era and is well positioned for its next phase of growth. I am proud to hand the reins to someone with Michael's caliber, expertise, and energy. He has the experience and the track record to carry Similarweb forward, and I look forward to supporting him through the transition.” 

 Michael Akkerman, incoming CEO of Similarweb, said, “Similarweb sits on one of the most valuable data assets in the industry - years of insight into how people navigate the digital world, online and in-app. I've been a customer since early in my career and have seen firsthand how turning this kind of intelligence into action drives meaningful business results. 

 “I'm humbled by the opportunity to build on the foundation that Or and the team have cemented, right at the inflection point when AI is reshaping how we interact with and measure the digital world, and at exactly the moment when understanding human behavior is at a premium. ## The former Digital Turbine and data.ai executive will take over in November as the Israeli digital intelligence company seeks to turn its data advantage into growth in the AI era. 

CTech

18:53, 24.09.26 

Similarweb is preparing for its first major leadership change since its founding, appointing Michael Akkerman as CEO as the Israeli digital intelligence company tries to turn its vast store of data about online behavior into a bigger business in the age of artificial intelligence.

Akkerman, currently chief business officer at Digital Turbine, will take over on November 2, 2026, Similarweb said Thursday. He will replace founder Or Offer, who is stepping down after nearly two decades as CEO but will remain involved during the transition.

1 View gallery 

Michael Akkerman. (Similarweb)

The appointment marks a faster timetable for a succession process that Similarweb disclosed in May. At the time, the company said its board had begun a formal search and expected the transition to be completed by mid-2027. 

The company said there will be no change to its strategy, operations or financial outlook as a result of the leadership transition. Its focus remains on scaling AI-powered data products and expanding its commercial operations in existing and new markets.

Akkerman’s background suggests that the board was looking for a commercially oriented operator rather than another founder or technology specialist. He has spent nearly two decades in senior positions spanning digital advertising, data and technology. At Digital Turbine, he oversees sales, partnerships, marketing, product and business operations.

Before joining Digital Turbine, Akkerman was chief revenue officer at data.ai, formerly known as App Annie, an app and market intelligence company whose customers overlap with Similarweb’s enterprise customer base. He previously served as chief product and strategy officer at Cardlytics, where he led product alongside engineering, and held senior commercial roles at Uber and Pinterest. Earlier in his career, he held global sales and strategy positions at Kenshoo, the Israeli-founded marketing software company now known as Skai.

He will be based at Similarweb’s New York office.

“Similarweb sits on one of the most valuable data assets in the industry - years of insight into how people navigate the digital world, online and in-app,” Akkerman said.

That data has been at the heart of Similarweb’s business since Offer founded the company in 2007. The company sells intelligence on website and application activity to businesses seeking to understand their markets, competitors and customers.

Similarweb

Similarweb Ltd. is a global software development and data aggregation company specializing in mobile app and web analytics, web traffic, digital performance, SEO tools and generative engine optimization tools. Founded in Israel, the company has 12 offices worldwide (as of 2021). [4] Similarweb went public on the New York Stock Exchange in May 2021. [5] 

## History

The company was founded in 2007 by Or Offer in Tel Aviv, Israel. While trying to scale up a jewelry business, Offer built a web analytics tool that would help him learn about the competition, which led to SimilarWeb's development. [6] [7] By 2009, Similarweb won the first Israeli SeedCamp, attracting the attention of international media and investors. The company was described as a competitor to Alexa. [8] 

On February 24, 2014, Naspers invested $18 million into Similarweb and leading their Series C round. Within a month, Similarweb used a part of the capital for the acquisition of Israeli early-stage company TapDog for a few million dollars in shares and cash, less than a year after TapDog was founded. [9] 

In May 2021, Similarweb made its public debut on the NYSE at a $1.6 billion valuation. [10] [11] 

## Technology

Similarweb develops tools that enable the analysis of the traffic and behavior of users on websites and apps. The service provides datasets and a platform marketed for individuals, teams, or companies requiring data for marketing, sales, and market research. The data is collected from a number of different sources that provide information about the internet and app usage of users, including various information partners, and anonymous data from users of the various dedicated browser addons that the company distributes. [12] [13] 

## Ranking

Similarweb ranks websites and apps based on traffic and engagement metrics. Its ranking is calculated according to the collected datasets and is updated on a monthly basis with new data. Also, The ranking system covers 210 categories of websites and apps in 190 countries and was designed to be an estimate of a website's popularity and growth potential. The company ranks websites based on traffic and engagement data, and ranks apps in the App Store (iOS/iPadOS) and Google Play Store based on downloads, installs and active user data.

## Acquisitions

Since its founding, Similarweb has made several acquisitions:

- 2015 – Swayy (personalized content discovery platform developer). [14] [15] 
- 2015 – Quettra, (mobile data insights/analytics provider). [16] [17] 
- 2021 – Embee (mobile data insights provider). [18] 
- 2022 – RankRanger (provides keyword rank tracking services and advanced APIs, that have been added to Similarweb's existing SEO tools). [19] 
- 2024 – Admetricks and 42matters (ad and app intelligence). [20] [21] 
- 2025 – The Search Monitor (paid search, affiliate marketing solutions). [22]

Similarweb Leadership - Founders & Management Team | Similarweb

# Our Leadership Team

Or Offer Co-Founder & CEO Or has been the CEO of Similarweb since the company’s founding in 2007. Under his leadership, the company has grown from a small Israeli startup to a global business with over 850 employees, 9 offices, and thousands of paying customers. Or was also a founding partner at AfterDownload (acquired by IronSource), and is an active investor in a number of startups. Or has been selected as one of the top 100 influencers in the Israeli high-tech scene and 40 under 40 most promising young people by TheMarker.

Ran Vered Chief Finance Officer Ran Vered has over 20 years of experience as a financial executive for global, publicly traded organizations. Throughout his career, Ran has held pivotal leadership roles, most recently serving as CFO of the SaaS data platform Lusha (2022–2025). Prior to that, he served as CFO for Ceragon (2019–2022) and Radcom (2016–2018). Ran also spent over a decade in various senior financial positions at Amdocs, culminating in his role as Director of Finance for the EMEA Division. He began his career as an auditor with KPMG. Ran is a certified CPA in Israel. He holds an MBA in Finance from Tel Aviv University and a BA in Business Administration and Accounting from the College of Management.

Ron Asher Chief Technology Officer Ron Asher has over 20 years of experience in R&D leadership roles in global companies. He most recently served as the VP of Engineering in Bond, where he performed as the R&D Leader, responsible for driving the vision, strategy and implementation for all technical aspects of the company’s products and services. Prior to this, Ron was the VP R&D for Startoscale and SVP Engineering in PrimaryData. Before that, Ron was the VP Engineering of Diligent Technologies that was acquired by IBM. After the acquisition by IBM, Ron acted as the head of the XIV division in IBM System and Technology Development department, scaling the department dramatically and driving substantial revenue growth. Ron holds a BSc in Statistics and Computer Science (graduated with distinction) and has coursework towards MSc in Computer Science from Tel-Aviv University. He is a graduate of the Israeli intelligence corps elite (8200) where he held a leadership role on a strategic project that won the Israeli Defense Prize awarded by the president of Israel.

Benjamin Seror Chief Product Officer Benjamin has over 14 years of experience leading product teams. Since joining Similarweb in 2012, Benjamin designed and launched the entire suite of Similarweb solutions including the Similarweb.com free product, Similarweb SaaS Platform, Similarweb API, and most recently, Similarweb Reports. Prior to that, Benjamin led the design and development of several multi-screen ad networks, including a leading platform used by China Mobile (Red Loop Media) and one of the first 3-screen ad networks (Amdocs). Benjamin holds B.S. and M.S. in Applied Mathematics from University Paris IX (Dauphine) and ENSAE (Ecole Nationale de La Statistiques appliquee a l’economie). 

Naama Kushnir Chief People Officer Naama Kushnir brings over 20 years of experience in HR and business transformation to her role as Chief People Officer at Similarweb. She leads global people strategy, focusing on talent development, organizational design, and cultural growth. Prior to joining Similarweb, Naama held executive roles at 888 Holdings PLC, (FTSE 250) including Chief Transformation Officer, COO, and CPO, where she played a key role in the $2.5B acquisition and integration of William Hill. She later advised companies across fintech, gaming, travel, and ad-tech on executive development, M&A integration, and organizational change. Naama holds a B.A. in Industrial Psychology and an M.A. in Human Resource Management, specializing in Organizational Design.
